Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the city where Pope Pius XI died. While the Pope died in Vatican City, he died at the Vatican Palace, which is physically located within the city of Rome, Italy. The title "Governor of the City" (Governatore della Città di Roma) refers specifically to the administrative head of Rome. There is no historical office titled "Governor of Vatican City State" (Vatican City is governed directly by the Pope/Sovereign). By assuming the question refers to a "Governor of Vatican City" post, the Planner set the entire search strategy on the wrong track, leading the WebSurfer to search for non-existent pages (like "Governor_of_Vatican_City_State") instead of searching for the end date of the "Governor of Rome" post, which is the correct interpretation of the query.
